notes: You can now look at other readers' cards: pick a reader in the Readers list (or press View full card under their small card) to put their card on the big board, read-only; Back to my card brings yours back

Tap any tile on another reader's card, big or small, to see its category and the book they chose (cover, title, author, year, description, and whether it is read or planned), or "No book chosen yet" for an empty tile; close it with the x button, Escape or a tap outside
The small cards in the Library work the same way: tap a tile to see its category and book
Your accounts and games are now backed up automatically: every time the server starts, every hour while anything changes, and just before a game or an account is removed
Saving is safer, so a crash or power cut in the middle of a save can no longer leave a half-written file
Clear tile now asks you to confirm before it empties a tile
The GM screen now fits phone screens: in the Readers list each name has its own line with its buttons wrapped beneath it, so the page no longer scrolls sideways
Gamemaster is now written GM on the Gamemaster screen and in the header (the GM link, the GM badge, Make GM), to save room on small screens
On narrow screens the header buttons and the tab bar (View games, Create a game, and the rest) now scroll sideways inside themselves instead of making the whole page scroll sideways
The sign-in title now fits the narrowest phone screens
First release: accounts and roles (master, Keeper, Gamemaster), bingo games with a free center, friends and invites, the Library, Open Library book search, and two security passes
Smooth gilt bands on the leaning book in the title
Two simultaneous sign-ups can no longer take the same name or both become master
Forwarded addresses can no longer be faked to dodge rate limits
Wrong-password lockouts are per address, so others can't lock you out
Limits on current-password guesses, new games and book lookups
Expired sessions are cleaned up; HSTS over https
Fixed: games with more than one reader would not open
New Keeper role: everything a Gamemaster can do, plus resetting the passwords of readers and Gamemasters
Gamemasters no longer reset passwords; only the master can make Keepers or reset a Keeper's password
Demote now steps down one rank (Keeper → Gamemaster → reader)
Docker image pins the master account to Mentdown1
Security pass: fixed a way for odd account ids to corrupt the server's internal objects
Requests from other websites can no longer act on your behalf
Sign-in, sign-up and game-code guessing are rate limited
Session tokens are stored hashed; security headers (CSP, no framing) added
Optional MASTER_USERNAME and TRUST_PROXY settings for deployment
Free space in the middle of every new card (24 tiles + free); it counts toward shelves
Gamemasters can reset a reader's password (only the master can reset the master's); the reader is signed out everywhere
Anyone can change their own password from the Password button
New Library tab: every finished game you played, with your card and your friends' cards
Gamemasters can switch the Library to All archives to see every finished game and every card
Search the Library by game or reader name
Readers list: the friend button shrinks to a single symbol when a long shelf would cut off the name
Shelf icons use 12 distinct books, in a different order for each reader
Title shelf is full size and centered on the sign-in page, and compact beside the menus everywhere else
Friends: send a request to anyone you share a game with; accept, decline or remove on the new Friends tab
Invite friends to a game from a scrollable checklist; a game with only you in it prompts you to invite
Invitations appear on the View games tab with Join and Decline
Bookworm title shelf is centered, with the account bar centered beneath it
First prototype: accounts (first account is master), Gamemaster role and tile library
Create, join (by code) and view games with start and end dates
25-tile cards shuffled per player, plus custom tiles per game
Open Library search with covers and descriptions; read or plan a book on any tile
Readers list with shelf (bingo) counts and every other reader's card below
